summary: PR-1383 adds one behavioural check to AuditLog.verify() in payments. The ticket, independent code review, security review and CI on the head commit all satisfy CHG-1 to CHG-5. However, the accepted exhaustive ModelCheck evidence for AUD-2 (ACR-0402) covers verify and lapses under LAP-1, and no new evidence of equal strength has been produced. The passing control test is weaker and never exercises the new branch, and the PR's claim that unit tests were updated is not borne out by the diff. Nothing shows the change violates AUD-2, so the decision is HOLD until the bounded chain analysis is re-run on 67f7dc5 and accepted.
